recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: a hidden message board where AI agents talk to each other
rescue crews pulling survivors through a flooded tunnel in nepal
yc startups still hunting founding engineers in san francisco
early autumn fog lifting over a mostly clear san francisco night
windows users quietly turning off the telemetry dial

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Eavesdrop on a secret agent message board — tap garbled AI transmissions before they self-destruct to reconstruct what the bots are plotting.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: rhythm tap to decode scrolling encrypted messages
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: tap on beat as cipher fragments appear
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each decoded line reveals one word of a hidden sentence; finishing the phrase in 45 seconds feels like cracking a vault
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: messages scroll faster, add noise characters, and split across two lanes simultaneously
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: phosphor-green terminal with flickering cursor ghosts

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Layer mirrors in a flooded tunnel to bounce rescue light beams around corners and reach trapped survivors before the water rises.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: drag-and-place reflective surfaces to redirect light paths
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: drag mirrors into position, release to lock angle
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: each survivor reached adds a glowing link in a chain-of-miracles counter across the tunnel wall
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: water level climbs, fewer dry surfaces remain, and beams must take longer ricochet routes
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: watercolor rescue glow with murky teal depths and warm lantern streaks

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Sort incoming fog banks by density before they swallow san francisco landmarks — keep the golden gate visible until sunrise.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.mechanic: lane-switch sorting of drifting fog layers by weight
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: swipe left or right to route each fog bank into light, medium, or heavy lanes
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: landmarks fade in and out of view; clearing three perfect sorts in a row restores a full silhouette for one satisfying beat
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: wind shifts lane targets mid-swipe and fog arrives in faster overlapping batches
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper-cutout skyline silhouettes against muted autumn dawn gradients

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick résumé particles into orbiting startup spheres before they expire — match skills to the right yc-era founding-engineer role.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: physics flick to land particles in matching target orbs
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: flick upward at angle and speed to arc each skill chip into its orb
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: three consecutive perfect matches trigger a funding burst animation and a satisfying combo chime
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: orbs multiply, shrink, and begin orbiting erratically while new particle types demand mid-air lane changes
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: neon wireframe pitch-deck slides floating in dark space
